task_summary: Full-codebase audit + 7 hypotheses + ranked literature-grounded remediation plan

steps.title: Accuracy audit of stat + matching path
steps.description: Using code-review + ps-scientific-critical-thinking, audit analytics.py (Spearman/Pearson per-band, AUC, binarization), availability.py/streaming_psd.py (matching, min_per_group gate), and bravo_service.py (scan assembly). Flag correctness risks: silent NaN drops, one-class skips, cap-vs-stat-n coupling, reuse semantics.

steps.title: Efficiency + flexibility review
steps.description: Assess workflow efficiency (redundant decodes, recompute triggers, memoization) and flexibility (hard-coded constants vs params: min_per_group, max_scatter, tolerance, band width). Produce a ranked findings list.

steps.title: Instrument one shared run_for_participant
steps.description: Add lightweight counters via a bridge probe on participant 2e3c75c0: per-band n_pairs, NaN-r reasons (std=0 / n<3), one-class AUC skips, min_per_group drops, live-strict vs legacy pair counts. One instrumented run feeds multiple hypotheses.

steps.title: H-T1: pair-count shrinkage = no-reuse + tolerance
steps.description: Test that live strict matching (nearest-only) yields far fewer PRO-neural pairs than legacy pooled match. Compare n_pro_matched, n_pooled, n_unmatched live vs legacy. Confirmed/refuted with numbers.

steps.title: H-T2: min_per_group=3 strands sparse bands
steps.description: Test that the min_per_group=3 gate in streaming_psd._match drops (channel,band) groups with <3 matched samples before correlation, removing otherwise-usable neural data. Count groups dropped and samples stranded.

steps.title: H-T3: max_scatter cap is display-only
steps.description: Verify the max_scatter=400 cap + dedup-by-rating affects only plotted points, not the r/AUC input n (or find it DOES truncate the stat). Compare stat-n vs plotted-n per channel.

steps.title: H-T4: Spearman ρ NaN from zero-variance LSB
steps.description: Test that bands with saturated/constant LSB (std(score)=0) or <3 finite pairs yield r=NaN and are dropped from the curve, a top blocker of the ρ plot. Count NaN-r bands by cause.

steps.title: H-T5: AUC skipped on one-class binarization
steps.description: Test that tertile binarization leaving all matched ratings in one class (no high OR no low) yields one-class folds → AUC skipped (n_skipped_test_one_class). Count skips and the bands affected.

steps.title: H-S1: beta-band LSB tracks pain rating
steps.description: Scientific: test that beta-band (13-30 Hz) LSB power shows positive Spearman ρ with pain rating in a subset of contacts, consistent with beta elevation in pain states. Report ρ sign/magnitude per beta band.

steps.title: H-S2: low-frequency power tracks pain
steps.description: Scientific: test that theta/alpha (4-12 Hz) band power correlates with pain rating in some contacts (affective pain processing). Report ρ per low-freq band; mark confirmed/refuted/inconclusive.

steps.title: Assemble stress-test report + suggestions
steps.description: Write the markdown stress-test summary: audit findings, per-hypothesis result (confirmed/refuted/inconclusive) with evidence, and ranked suggestions for prediction accuracy, workflow efficiency, and flexibility. Save report + per-hypothesis CSVs as artifacts.

steps.title: Build ranked remediation action plan (pass 1)
steps.description: PRIMARY DELIVERABLE. Synthesize every audit finding + hypothesis result into a single ranked action plan of next steps, gap-fills, and flaw remediations. Rank each item code-review style: 🔴 High / 🟡 Medium / 🟢 Low priority. Each item: problem, evidence (which finding/hypothesis), proposed fix, affected files.

steps.title: Detail pass + literature grounding (pass 2)
steps.description: Iterate once more over the action plan and DOUBLE the detail/specification per item: concrete parameter values, code locations, acceptance tests, effort estimate. Where a spec is unclear/missing (e.g. min_per_group floor, tolerance window, band definitions, saturation threshold), search PubMed/literature via the pubmed-database + lit-search skills and prefer empirical literature-backed values over assumptions; cite sources inline. Save as the single cohesive ranked remediation deliverable.

desired_outputs: PRIMARY: single cohesive ranked, detailed, literature-grounded remediation/enhancement action plan (🔴/🟡/🟢 priorities, two-pass detail) as a markdown artifact
Codebase stress-test summary (accuracy/efficiency/flexibility) as a markdown artifact
Improvement suggestions across prediction accuracy, workflow efficiency, and flexibility
7 labeled testable hypotheses (2 scientific + 5 technical), each with a pipeline-run result: confirmed / refuted / inconclusive
Per-hypothesis evidence tables (CSV) from instrumented bridge runs on participant 2e3c75c0

feasibility.rationale: All code is local and the live pipeline is reachable via the orbstack bridge; the matching/stat path was just inspected and the drop-gates (min_per_group=3, std>0, one-class AUC skip, no-reuse) are concrete and instrumentable. The capstone remediation plan is a synthesis step grounded in the audit + hypothesis evidence, with PubMed lookups to fill any unspecified parameter floors. Scientific-hypothesis confirmation depends on this single participant's data.
